executeArbunDelivery((address,address,ui.details: Fulfills the Shariah Arbun requirement (Qabd) by physically swapping on standardPoolKey.

isLiquidatable((address,uint256,uint256,.details: Threshold decreases as leverage increases, giving higher-leverage positions more      breathing room before liquidation — improving UX and margin aggregator risk scores.      Formula: 120% - (leverage × 2%), so higher leverage is more forgiving:        2x → 116%,  3x → 114%,  5x → 110%,  10x → 100% (hard floor).      The result is floored at 10000 (100%) to always require positive collateral.

returns.capsActive: False when tracked TVL is below the floor (uncapped regime).

positionCurrencies((address,address,uint.details: Needed by off-chain/keeper consumers because `isLong` is anchored to the      pool's configured base currency (see setBaseCurrency) and therefore no      longer maps 1:1 to currency0.

returns.fits: True when the order would pass every size gate.
returns.reason: Empty string when fits; otherwise a stable machine code         aggregators can map to their own error taxonomy.

registerMarginOpen((address,address,uint.details: Accounting mirrors afterSwap's margin block exactly: protocol-fee      split, claim-balance mirror of the minted 6909, TVL/OI trackers and      the Position record. Risk gates come from the same _validateOpen used      by beforeSwap, so both execution modes enforce identical limits.

registerTradingPair((address,address,uin.details: One owner transaction authorizes the hook pool, pins the deep standard      pool used by close/liquidation unwind swaps, anchors the base currency      (what "long" means for this pair), and records both tokens' decimals      for the TWAP circuit breaker. The pool itself must already be      initialized on the PoolManager with this hook (permissionless via      pm.initialize), and oracle feeds must be registered on the PriceFeed      via setPriceFeed(). See scripts/v4/AddPair.s.sol for the full flow.

setBaseCurrency(bytes32,address).details: Determines the meaning of the reported `isLong` flag: a position whose      collateral is the base token is LONG, otherwise SHORT. Defaults to      currency0 when unset. On Unichain (currency0=USDC, currency1=WETH) set      this to WETH so "long WETH" positions report isLong=true.

setRouterAndMinCollateralUsd(address,uin.details: Combining both one-time prod configs saves a dispatch (~gas + bytes).      `minCollateralUsd` is 18-decimals: position margins are valued via the      oracle and must meet this USD threshold; 0 restores the legacy raw-token      MIN_COLLATERAL floor.

setTokenDecimals(address,uint8).details: Required for pools containing non-18-decimal tokens (e.g. 6-decimal USDC)      so the V4-spot vs V3-TWAP circuit breaker compares like-for-like prices.      Unconfigured tokens are assumed to be 18 decimals.

sweepableResidue(address).details: Obligation floor = trader collateral claims (`totalCollateral`) +      insurance fund + accrued protocol fees. Registered solver debts are      senior claims against position collateral already counted inside      `totalCollateral`, so they need no separate reservation. Sources of      residue: the open fee retained on collateral (50bps default),      settlement rounding dust, and direct donations.

bandConsumptionTriggerBps().notice: Fraction of a collateral band's width that price may consume from         the collateral side before rebalancePosition re-centers an         IN-RANGE band, in bps of band width. 2500 = 25%. Prevents the         stuck window where a sweep converts most of the collateral into         the debt currency while rebalance waits for full band exit.

closePosition((address,address,uint24,in.notice: Closes a leveraged margin position, settling solver debt and returning profit.

executeArbunDelivery((address,address,ui.notice: Converts a synthetic Arbun position into physical asset delivery on Uniswap V4.

getHookTVL(address).notice: Returns the total value locked within the hook for a specific currency.

getIndicativeQuote((address,address,uint.notice: Provides an indicative quote for a swap through the hook's custom accounting.

getSwappableCapacity(address).notice: Returns the immediately swappable liquidity (capacity) of the hook.

heldReserve(address).notice: ERC6909 claim balance the hook physically holds inside the PoolManager.

insuranceWithdrawalCapBps().notice: Withdraws physically settled tokens from the Insurance Fund.

isLiquidatable((address,uint256,uint256,.notice: Returns the dynamic liquidation threshold for a position in basis points of collateralization.

maxOpenBorrowRaw(address).notice: Largest borrow (raw units of `inputCurrency`) a NEW leveraged         (>1x) position may take right now without hitting an OI cap.         Returns 0 when the caps are inactive — that means "no protocol         ceiling", not "no capacity".

positionCurrencies((address,address,uint.notice: Resolves the collateral and debt currencies for a trader's position.

protocolFeeFor(address).notice: Effective protocol fee (bps) charged to `trader`: the per-address         override when set, otherwise the global `reserveFactor`.

quoteOpenFit((address,address,uint24,int.notice: Non-reverting dry-run of every size gate applied on open:         leverage bounds, duplicate position, collateral floor and the         OI caps. The TWAP circuit breaker is state-dependent and is         only evaluated at execution time.

registerMarginOpen((address,address,uint.notice: Multi-pool deep-fill open: records a position whose physical swap         executed on the standard (no-hook) pool. The router calls this         inside the same unlock AFTER funding both input legs and BEFORE         minting the collateral ERC-6909 claim to this hook.

registerTradingPair((address,address,uin.notice: Adds a NEW trading pair at runtime — no protocol redeploy needed.

seedInsuranceFund(address,uint256).notice: Seed the insurance fund using physical ERC20s, converting them to 6909s.

setAddressProtocolFee(address,uint256).notice: Sets a protocol-fee override (basis points of position collateral)         for ONE specific address. Everyone else keeps paying the global         `reserveFactor`. Set bps = 0 to fall back to the default fee.

setBaseCurrency(bytes32,address).notice: Configures the base (underlying) token for a pool.

setEmergencyPause(bool).notice: Toggles the emergency pause. When active, all new position opens         (beforeSwap margin mode + registerMarginOpen) are blocked.         Close, liquidate, and rebalance remain operational so existing         positions can be safely wound down.

setRouterAndMinCollateralUsd(address,uin.notice: Sets the router and the USD-denominated collateral floor together.

setTokenDecimals(address,uint8).notice: Configures the ERC-20 decimals for a pool token.

sweepResidue(address,address,uint256).notice: Owner sweep of protocol-owned residue to an arbitrary recipient         (normally the treasury). Hard-capped at `sweepableResidue` so a         compromised owner key can never strand trader collateral,         insurance backing or accrued fees.

sweepableResidue(address).notice: Tokens held beyond every ledgered obligation — the only amount         `sweepResidue` may move.

transferOwnership(address).notice: Transfers hook ownership to a new address. Only callable by current owner.         Use with TimelockController for time-gated governance.

withdrawProtocolFee(address,uint256).notice: Withdraws accumulated protocol fee revenue (reserve factor on each trade)         to the configured treasury. Reverts until a treasury is set via setConfig.
